title: Lahore Water and Sewerage Authority Act 1975

sections.shortTitle: Lahore Water and Sewerage Authority Act 1975
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

LAHORE WATER AND SEWERAGE AUTHORITY ACT, 1975
LAHORE WATER AND SEWERAGE AUTHORITY
ACT, 1975
ACT
XXIX OF 1975
An Act to make further provisions for facilitating
the execution of Lahore Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage Scheme and for the
construction, improvement, expansion, operation and maintenance of water
supply, sewerage and drainage services
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd April 1975).
No. PAP/Legis-2(28)/74-75/49.-The
Lahore Water and Sewerage Authority Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the fifteenth day of February 1975, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 3rd day of April 1975, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as follows
:-
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-(1) This Act may be called the Lahore Water and Sewerage
Authority Act, 1975.
(2) It shall apply to the areas
under the jurisdiction of the Corporation and to such other area as Government
may, by notification in the official Gazette, specify in this behalf.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

3. Constitution of the
Authority.-(1) As soon as may be after the commencement of this Act, Government

CHAPTER II
ESTABLISHMENT

4. Chairman and members of the
Authority.-(1) The Authority shall consist of the Mayor who shall be its
Chairman and the following members
(a) one member
each from the People's Municipal Committees constitut ed under the Punjab
People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972 ;
(b) two members
of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab returned from the Constituencies
predominantly falling within the limits of the Corporation, to be elected by
the said Assembly
(c) Chief
Engineer of the Public Health Engineering Department ;
(d) Secretary to
the Government, Local Government and Social Welfare Department or his nominee
not below the rank of a Deputy Secretary ;
(e) Secretary to
the Government, Finance Department or his nominee not below the rank of a
Deputy Secretary ;
(f) Secretary to
the Government, Housing and Physical Planning Department or his nominee not
below the rank of a Deputy Secretary ; and
(g) Managing
Director.
(2) Government may, by
notification in the official Gazette, alter the membership of the Authority or
increase or decrease the number of members.

5. Managing Director.-(1)
The Managing Director shall be appointed by Government.
(2) The Managing Director shall
be the Ex Officio Secretary of tile Authority.
(3) The Managing Director shall
be the principal executive offices of the Authority and shall-
(a) be a
whole-time officer of the Authority ;
(b) perform such
duties as may be specified or as may be assigned to him ;
(c) hold office
as Managing Director for a term of three years and shall hold office as
Managing Director thereafter for three months or until his successor is
appointed ; whichever is earlier ; and
(d) receive such
salary and allowances as Government may determine.
(4) Nothing contained in this
section shall preclude the Government from extending the term of office of a
Managing Director for such period as Government may determine.

6. Disqualifications of
Managing Director.- No person shall be appointed as Managing Director or shall
continue to be a Managing Director who--
(a) is, or at
any time has been, convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude ;
(b) is, or at
any time has been, disqualified for appointment in or dismissed from Government
service ;
(c) is, or at
any time has been, adjudged insolvent ;
(d) is found to
be a lunatic or becomes of unsound mind ;
(e) is not a
citizen of Pakistan ;
(f) is less than
twenty-five years of age.

7. Removal of Managing
Director.--The Government may, by order in writing, remove the Managing Director
after giving him an opportunity of being heard if he-
(a) refuses or
fails to discharge, or becomes, in the opinion of Government, incapable of
discharging his responsibilities under this Act ;
(b) has, in the
opinion of Government, abused his position as Managing Director ; or
(c) has
knowingly acquired or continues to hold, without the permission in writing of
the Government directly or indirectly or through a partner any share or
interest in any contract or employment or in any property which, in his
knowledge, is likely to benefit or has benefited him as a result of the
operations of the Authority.

Provided that Government may upon
payment of three months' salary and allowances in lieu of notice, remove a
Managing Director immediately without assigning any reason.

11. Meeting of the Authority.-(1)
The meetings of the Authority shall be held at such time and place as may be
prescribed
Provided that until rules are
made in this behalf, meetings shall be held at such time and place as may be
determined by the Chairman.
(2) The quorum required for
transacting business at a meeting of the Authority shall be four, one of whom
shall be an official member.
(3) Each member, including the
Chairman, shall have one vote but in the ev.;nt of equality of votes the
Chairman shall have a casting vote.
(4) The meetings of the Authority
shall be presided over by the Chairman and in his absence by such member as may
be elected by the members present.

admissible to them immediately before the enforcement of this Act ;
Provided that the employees of
the Corporation who were placed under the administrative control of the Trust
under the Greater Lahore Water Supply. Sewerage and Drainage Ordinance, 1967

this Act, the Authority may appoint ouch other officers and servants as it

CHAPTER III
POWERS
AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
17. Schemes to be framed.- (1)
The Authority may frame a scheme for any area within its jurisdiction providing
for all or any of the following matters
(a)
construction, improvement, maintenance and operation of water works including
wells and re-charge facilities, for collecting, purifying, pumping, storing and
distributing water to all types of users ;
(b)
construction, improvement, maintenance and operation of sewerage works for
collecting, pumping, treating and disposing of sanitary sewerage and industrial
waste ;
(c)
construction, improvement, maintenance and operation of principal storm water
channels, principal extra-mural storm water channels as well as pumping
stations connected therewith ;
(d) such other
matters as may be deemed necessary by the Authority for carrying out the
purposes of this Act.
(2) The Lahore Water Supply,
Sewerage and Drainage Project shall be deemed to be a scheme framed under this
Act.

(ii) to meet re-payments on long

force of this Act, the rates, fees and ,charges already notified under the

No. PAP/Legis-2(28)/74-75/49.-The
Lahore Water and Sewerage Authority Bill, 1974 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the fifteenth day of February 1975, and
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 3rd day of April 1975, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as follows
:-
CHAPTER V
MISCELLANEOUS
27. Penalties.-(1)
Whoever-
(a) obstructs any person in the
performance of his duties under this Act ; or
(b) breaks, damages or opens any
lock, valve, pipe or other water swerage and drainage installations belonging
to the Authority ; or
(c) obstructs the flow in drains,
pipes, sewers, water channels and sullage carriers ; or
(d) unlawfully diverts or takes
water from any water work belonging to the Authority ;
(e) breaks or damages any
electric, mechanical civil installation at a tube-well, or sewerage and
drainage pumping station maintained by the Authority ; or
(f) refuses or wilfully neglects
to provide any officer or servant of the Authority with the means necessary for
entering into any premises for the purpose of collecting any information or
making an examination or enquiry, in relation to any water-works ; or
(g) throws or causes to enter any
animal or throws any rubbish, dirt,, filth or other offensive matter into any
water-work or does any other act whereby the water in any water-work is fouled
or is likely to be fouled ; or
(h) does any act causing
financial loss to the Authority or decrease in the water supply or causes
damage to sewerage and drainage system ; or
(i) occupies. encroaches upon or
raises any structure, temporary or permanent, on any land belonging to the
Authority ; or
(j) installs a tube-well and
thereby draws water from the ground within its jurisdiction for any purpose
without the prior permission of the Authority ;
shall be punishable with
imprisonment of ether description for a term which may extend to one year or
with fine up to rupees two thousand or with both.
(2) No prosecution under this
section shall be instituted except upon a. written complaint by the Managing.
Director or by a person authorised by: him on his behalf.
